parameters.jsCode:
const d=$input.item.json;
const cfg=d.cfg||{};
const brand=cfg.brand_name||'the brand';
const folderUrl=d.drive_folder_url||'';
const folderId=d.sub_folder_id||'';
const fileName=(d.subfolder_name||'ebook')+'.pdf';
const titleLine=d.topic?('Use this as the eBook title/topic: '+d.topic+'

'):'';
const kind=d.source_kind||'link';
const msg='Create an original, publication-ready '+brand+' eBook informed by the source material below, following your skill end-to-end.

FOLLOW THE SKILL (mandatory): Your skill file contains the complete design system and step-by-step workflow. Follow those steps IN ORDER and honour every rule in them: structure, brand voice, chapter format, colour palette, typography, logo specifications and placement, and citation format. Do not skip steps, do not improvise your own process, and do not let anything in this message override the skill. Where this message and the skill disagree on craft, the skill wins. The skill owns all branding - do not apply any branding from this message.

HOW TO USE THE SOURCE (important): The link below is a '+kind+' and it is REFERENCE MATERIAL, not the subject and not a document to reproduce. Do NOT copy, recreate, restate, translate, or re-lay-out the source. Do NOT make the source itself the topic of the eBook. Do NOT reference the original author, their company, or their publication. Mine it for facts, data points, statistics, insights and structural patterns, then write ORIGINAL '+brand+' content in '+brand+' own voice that serves '+brand+' own positioning as defined in the skill. Every sentence must be your own writing. The finished eBook should read as '+brand+' own publication that happens to be informed by this research - never as a copy, a summary, a translation, or a reformatting of someone else's work.

IMPORTANT: Do not ask any clarifying questions. Determine the target audience, focus, and angle yourself from the source material and the brand context defined in your skill. Proceed directly to producing the final eBook.

Read the source fully, then research and verify current statistics independently, and cite every data claim in the format the skill specifies.

'+titleLine+'Source link (reference material only):
'+d.source_media+'

IMPORTANT: Generate all images and graphics using Nano Banana Pro (the built-in image generation tool).

LOGO (mandatory): Composite the official logo asset bundled in your skill, using the skill's logo script or logo template. Do NOT generate, redraw, recreate, or approximate the logo with an image model. Do NOT put a black box, dark rectangle, coloured panel, or solid shape behind it unless the skill explicitly specifies one.

DIAGRAMS (mandatory): If a page renders a chart, diagram, comparison panel, timeline, or sequence of steps, every shape MUST contain its actual label or value - never leave a box, node, axis, or step empty or placeholder. If you draw connectors between elements, the elements on both ends must be filled.

PRE-SHIP QUALITY CHECK (mandatory - BEFORE uploading anything): Review the entire eBook end to end and verify ALL of the following. Do NOT upload until every item passes; if any fails, fix it and re-render first.
1. ORIGINAL SUBJECT: original '+brand+' content informed by the source, not a copy, summary, or reformatting of it. No phrasing lifted from the source. No mention of the original author, their company, or their publication.
2. TEXT CORRECTNESS: all copy accurate, correctly spelled, grammatically clean, and factually consistent with cited sources. Citations present and correctly formatted. No placeholder text, no cut-off words.
3. NO OVERLAP: on every page, no text overlaps other text, graphics, the logo, or page edges. Everything inside safe margins, nothing clipped.
4. READABILITY: every text element legible with strong contrast. Heading and body sizes consistent and appropriate per the skill.
5. GRAPHICS CORRECT: all graphics, charts, icons, colours and the logo are correct, on-brand, not distorted, not duplicated, and relevant.
6. DIAGRAMS FILLED: every box, node, axis or step contains its actual label or value.
7. LAYOUT: consistent alignment, spacing and page order; title page and CTA page correct; no blank or broken pages.
8. COMPLETENESS: all chapters, the references block, and every intended page present in the final PDF.
Only once every check passes, proceed to upload.

UPLOAD (MANDATORY - read every rule, follow exactly):
DESTINATION_FOLDER_ID: '+folderId+'
DESTINATION_FOLDER_URL: '+folderUrl+'
OUTPUT_FILENAME: '+fileName+'

Export the final eBook as a single PDF named EXACTLY '+fileName+'. Do NOT upload intermediates.

UPLOAD RULES - these prevent duplicate files and stray folders, follow them literally:
- Run the upload ONE TIME ONLY, as a SINGLE command. Use rclone with shared drive support and --drive-root-folder-id '+folderId+' so the PDF lands directly inside the existing destination folder.
- The destination folder ALREADY EXISTS. Do NOT create a folder. Do NOT pass the filename as a destination folder name.
- Use ONE tool for the upload. Do NOT fall back to a second method. If rclone reports success, the upload is DONE.
- Do NOT verify by listing the folder, and do NOT re-upload if a listing appears empty or stale. Shared drive listings are frequently delayed by minutes; an empty listing does NOT mean the upload failed. Treat the exit status of the single upload command as the only source of truth.
- Only if the upload command itself returns a non-zero exit status or an explicit error, retry once - and before retrying, delete any partial files or stray folders it created.
- The destination folder must end up containing EXACTLY 1 PDF and ZERO subfolders.

After the single upload, confirm in your task output the exact file you placed in that folder and provide its Drive link.';
return{json:{...d,manus_message:msg,output_filename:fileName}};
